terms.gloss: try, attempt; put to the test
evidence: Cic. Leg. 1.59: cum sē ipse perspexerit tōtumque temptārit (Lewis & Short s.v. tentō)
terms.comment: cōnor is to make an effort to do something; temptō is to try something out, test it, or make an attempt on it.

phrases.english: Do you want to try again?

sources: Lewis & Short: conor · Lewis & Short: iterum
